headline: Hedge Funds Exit Arbitrage Positions on Quebecor-Telus Acquisition Bid
summary: Hedge funds unwound positions on Quebecor and Telus following an acquisition proposal by the Montreal-based telecom company for its Vancouver peer that sparked heavy TSX trading volume.
why: Consolidation bids among Canadian telecom operators face severe regulatory hurdles from competition regulators, prompting rapid arbitrage unwinds.

impacts.name: Quebecor
impacts.why: Its acquisition bid for Telus drove major volume shifts and subsequent arbitrage position closures.
